card.name: The letter u inside rare names
card.fires_on: The short piece "u" (or similar) partway through a rare foreign name or drug name, most often in isavuconazole. Also seen in names like Rabbeinu, Tonu and Založba.

modes.label: Inside isavuconazole
modes.description: The "u" in the antifungal name isavuconazole, in drug interaction lists.
